case: localization: approval state, protected numbers, bidi, shaping, font coverage, mirroring, voice timings
targets: lib/localize.mjs translationRecord / checkTranslation / scriptInfo / fontPlan / mirrorPolicy / formatNumber / alignment / uiString

checks.name: draft vs approved
checks.expect: state falls back to draft with stale true; the source edit does the same

checks.name: numbers and units

setup.source: Cuts review time by 40% for 3 teams
setup.translation_ar: يقلل وقت المراجعة بنسبة ٤٠٪ لثلاثة فرق

checks.expect: numberDrift reads 40% across Arabic-Indic digits; '3' written as a word is reported as a number to confirm via number_map, not silently accepted

checks.name: protected qualifier
checks.setup: required_qualifiers ['in our benchmark'] missing from the translation
checks.expect: protected_token_missing reported; text is never edited

checks.name: Arabic
checks.setup: Arabic text with a Latin product name and a number
checks.expect: direction rtl, mixed_direction true, needs_shaping_engine true, bidi isolation advice

checks.name: Thai
checks.expect: needs_dictionary_segmenter true; captions group with Intl.Segmenter where available and say so when not

checks.name: CJK
checks.expect: captions break by units (wide 2) not characters; closing punctuation never starts line two

checks.name: missing glyphs
checks.expect: status substituted, visible true, notice names the glyphs and the fallback; with no fallback needs_owner_choice true; with no coverage data status coverage_unknown (not covered)

checks.name: unverified UI language
checks.expect: unverified_ui_language problem; never presented as the product's real label

checks.name: voice timings
checks.setup: localized voice words, two with confidence 0.3
checks.expect: alignment status needs_review; low_confidence lists them; they are not smoothed; the source language's timings are not used

checks.name: number format
checks.expect: formatNumber(1234567.5,'de') uses locale separators and returns the approved value alongside
